records.Description: In the storyline of Rixxy Warriors, the research vessel en route to Sarr 388 encountered a significant Rixxy attack. Your mission is to break through this onslaught, eliminating as many Rixxies as possible to ensure the safety of the research vessel.

records.Name: Street Hoops · Red Prime
records.Description: Pinchbot, only three months into the game, is now a star player for the Chaos Basketball Team in Paradox Plaza. With mad hours of practice, he’s nailing those free throws. Difficulty: ★

records.Description: Catch the heat with Luminary Academy’s star forward and the hoop dream sensation with a legion of followers! This baller’s got game and a notorious beef with Red Prime that’s got the streets buzzin’… Difficulty: ★★

records.Name: Street Hoops · Chef
records.Description: Step into the kitchen and the court with MM’s cafeteria king and the Captain of the MM basketball team – the Chef. Serving up spicy curry and sizzling crossovers, he’s the undisputed “Double Threat.” Difficulty: ★★★★

records.Name: Street Hoops · 40K
records.Description: Meet “40K,” the enigmatic hoop phenomenon storming the scene straight outta Nova. With a rap sheet claiming 40,000 points. This legend leaves his opponents shook, ducking rematches… Difficulty: ★★★★★
